name: Disadvantaged Communities Assessment
description: CEQR Technical Manual Chapter 23 — Effects on Disadvantaged Communities. Implements the Environmental Justice Siting Law (EJSL) assessment framework: identifies whether a project is within or proximate to a NYS Disadvantaged Community (DAC), retrieves burden and vulnerability indicators for affected census tracts, and screens for potential disproportionate pollution burden per ECL §8-0109 and §8-0113.

legislative_basis.primary: NYS Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act (2019)
legislative_basis.implementing: Environmental Justice Siting Law (Chapter 840, 2022; amended Chapter 49, 2023)

inputs.name: project_polygon
inputs.description: Project site boundary as GeoJSON polygon. If provided, buffer is calculated from boundary rather than centroid.

inputs.name: project_description
inputs.description: Brief description of proposed action for pollution screening context

inputs.name: ceqr_technical_areas
inputs.description: List of CEQR technical areas with identified potential impacts (e.g., ['air_quality', 'noise', 'hazardous_materials']). Used for pollution burden relevance screening.

inputs.name: buffer_distance_miles
inputs.description: Study area buffer distance in miles. Default is 0.5 miles per CEQR Ch. 23 Section 320.

outputs.name: screening_determination
outputs.description: Binary screening result: is the project within or proximate to a DAC, and does it warrant further assessment?

outputs.name: dac_tracts_geojson
outputs.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of DAC census tracts within the study area, with indicator data as properties.

outputs.name: study_area_geojson
outputs.description: GeoJSON of the study area buffer polygon.

outputs.name: burden_summary
outputs.description: Aggregated burden and vulnerability indicator summary for affected DAC tracts.

outputs.name: eaf_responses
outputs.description: Pre-populated responses for the DAC-related questions on the Short and Full Environmental Assessment Forms.

outputs.name: screening_report
outputs.description: Narrative screening report suitable for inclusion in an EAS or EIS.

data_dependencies.name: nys_dac_tracts
data_dependencies.source: NYS Climate Justice Working Group via NYSERDA/DEC
data_dependencies.description: Census tracts designated as DACs under the Climate Act (45 indicators, ~35% of NYS tracts)

data_dependencies.name: dac_indicators
data_dependencies.description: 45 indicator percentile values for each census tract, grouped by factor

data_dependencies.name: nyc_census_tracts
data_dependencies.description: Census tract boundaries for spatial overlay analysis

notes: This module implements the screening-level assessment. The disproportionate burden comparison (DACAT methodology — comparing subject DAC to statewide/regional non-DAC aggregates) requires additional data from DEC's DACAT tool. At the screening stage, the key determination is proximity and identification of relevant burden indicators, not the full disproportionality calculation.
